confirmed.endGame: on_end_game reveals roles and marks stage end_game; game_statistics_saved retrieves stats and breakConnection; no explicit games/quit or exit_game in these handlers
confirmed.autoRedirect: on_stop_game reason.code=gameOver AND matching gameId -> breakConnection and /game-search after 2000ms

searchQuit.successCriterion: Response.ok only; JSON body is not read

confirmed.roomExit: room UI confirmation -> room socket exit_game, breakConnection and finishGame link; viewer only disconnect+finishGame
confirmed.additionalExit: search in_game handler may wire game-in-progress callback -> search socket quit_game; no server ACK contract shown for that exit

notEstablished: that on_end_game or game_statistics_saved itself clears the server game affiliation
whether /api/games/quit has an is_alive/isWarning response property; the current client never parses its response JSON
a separate read-only API proving that quitting will not count as leaving a live match
authenticated preconnect acceptance while still in a finished room
actual server latency or priority advantage
safeScopeForFastPath: positive completed-game state in current game identity, explicit user click, preserved skip-confirm preference and cross-tab live-match check; preconnect alone sends no start/quit; await successful quit before start; handle in_game/unknown response and navigation races

direct: Preserve successful queue acknowledgement in the handoff; an unconfirmed in_game reply does not navigate back to the old room.
Record first send, latest send and retry number separately.
Read authenticated queue availability before preparing the socket, matching the normal site selection rules without starting a search.
postgame: Revalidate room eligibility at the actual button click.
Ignore results of obsolete cross-tab live-match probes.
Stop for unrelated modals even while the expected confirmation is visible.
Refresh the live-match check before final confirmation after a long user wait.

optimizationDecision: The fast HTTP-quit then prepared-socket start path for a positively finished match is recommended but not implemented in this patch. Existing viewer/eliminated/manual-confirm behavior remains distinct. Removing the 8-second settle without a confirmed exit would restore the known in_game/loader race.
